blocks.text: Biochemistry is the branch of science that deals with the chemical substances found in living organisms and the reactions they undergo. Biological compounds are complex molecules, but they contain the same kinds of functional group as simple organic compounds: alcohol, amine, aldehyde, ketone, carboxylic acid, ester and amide groups.

This chapter covers the essential biomolecules, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids, with their structures, functions and roles in the cell, and also the roles of enzymes and minerals in biochemical processes.
